g1.flow: Word for word the same: yā ayyuha n-nabiyyu jāhidi l-kuffāra wa l-munāfiqīn. Both follow an ayah about gardens beneath which rivers flow, so use the details. At-Tawbah: believing men and women, 'approval from Allāh is greater', then they swear by Allāh they said nothing. At-Taḥrīm: sincere repentance, 'perfect for us our light', then the wives of Noah and Lot. Hook: 9 moves on to oaths, 66 to two wives.

cues.9:73: After gardens and 'approval from Allāh is greater'; next, they swear they said nothing.
cues.66:9: After sincere repentance and 'perfect for us our light'; next, the wives of Noah and Lot.
